production of molybdenum concentrates in China (including 47% Mo) in 2009 was 155,319 
tonnes. The Group's production of molybdenum concentrates accounted for approximately 21% 
of the total amount produced in China in 2009. According to an international research institution, 
the world’s molybdenum production was approximately 430 million pounds for the year 2009, of 
which approximately 34 million pounds were produced by the Group, representing 
approximately 7.9% of the total production of the world for the year 2009. 
Satisfactory progress has been made to the Group's major projects. In 2009, the Group 
completed its smelting plant with a capacity of 40,000 tonnes per year (Phase I project), the 
Luoyang High Tech 1,500-tonne-per-year molybdenum downstream processing production line 
project at Luoyang High Tech and the Yongning Gold Company 80,000-tonne-per-year 
comprehensive smelting plant project. 
It is expected molybdenum prices would grow by 20-30% with the uptrend of steel products 
prices, said Wu Wenjun, general manager with China Molybdenum Co., Ltd. (China 
Molybdenum, or "Luomu", HK3993). He also pointed that the company's average selling price of 
molybdenum was 108,500yuan/t with gross profit declining by 21% due to the sluggish overseas 
demand. 
The company commissioned its first phase molybdenum project in Luoyang High-tech 
Development Zone in Henan province on Mar 23. 
Involving 680mln yuan of investment, the first phase project was put into construction in Mar 
2008, which includes molybdenum roaster system, sulfuric acid production system, 
ferromolybdenum production, and waste acid treatment system. It is capable of producing 
20ktpa molybdenum concentrate, 18kt molybdenum oxide, 16kt ferromolybdenum and 22kt 
sulfuric acid.

2010

issue the first batch export quota of industrial products for foreign investment enterprises in 2010.
The quota for coke and rare earth will be in line with the export volume and value of every 
enterprises in Jan.-Oct. from 2007-2009 as well as the supply volume in 2008. 
The quota for tungsten, antimony and silver will be allocated on the basis of each enterprise's 
export volume, value and output in Jan.-Oct. from 2007-2009 
MOFCOM requires every foreign investment enterprises hand in related materials to it before 
Mar. 31, and the second batch of export quota will be carried out as soon as quickly.

News in Brief 
Gold 
 
Zijin 
projects 
to 
complete one or two 
overseas 
acquisitions in 2010 
 
Zijin Mining Co., Ltd, China’s top listed gold producer (Zijin, SH601899, 
HK 2899) plans to finish one or two acquisitions overseas in 2010, the 
company announced recently. 
Zijin also said it would like to purchase several large-size gold mines in 
China, but detail information is not available. 
World Gold Commission predicted the gold consumption in next ten 
years in China would increase by 100% in the credit of strong demand. In 
Dec. 2009, Zijin agreed to pay US$501mln to Indophil Resource Co. for 
acquiring the undeveloped large copper and gold deposits based in 
South-east Asia. 
Zijin spent US$300mln in 8 overseas projects in last five years. 
 
MF fails in acquiring 
a 
Shandong 
gold 
mine  
 
The agreement signed by Ming Fung Jewellery Group Limited (MF, 
HK:00860) previously to acquire 80% shares of a gold mine based in 
Shandong has already been abandoned due to some reasons. 
The agreement was signed in Aug. 2009, in which MF intended to buy 
80% shares of the gold mine with 200million yuan.  
Ming Fung Jewellery Group Limited is a world-class designer and 
manufacturer of high-class jewellery products. 
 
NEEC to acquire 90% 
shares of Hongwen 
Gold 
 
New Times Energy Co., Ltd (NTEC, HK:00166) plans to spend 600million 
HK dollars in acquiring 90% shares of Hongwen Gold Co.based in Hebei 
Province which owns three gold mines, and they hold a total of 3.9mlnt gold 
resource. 
Based in Hongkong, NTEC is engaged in nonferrous metals business, 
property investment and development and supplying financial service. 
 
Henan Jinqu Gold to 
develop gold mine in 
Australia 
Henan Jinqu Gold Company Limited (Henan Jinqu Gold) signed an 
agreement with Citigold, a gold producer based in Australia to jointly 
establish a company to develop the latter's gold project.  
Henan Jinqu Gold may acquire 50% of the new company, which owns 
1.8mln oz gold resource. 
 Henan Jinqu Gold is engaged in researching, developing and producing 
high-grade artificial diamond. 
 
The gold reserve in 
Shandong 
in 
2009 
increases by 229.6t 
 
 
 In 2009, Shandong newly discovered 229.6t gold reserve, which is 
estimated to have 57billion yuan potential economy value. 
Last year, Shandong Province invested 900milliion yuan in exploration 
and proved two super large gold deposits based in Jiaojia and Yunzhou.   
Besides, 1.12blnt coal and 1.16blnt iron ore resource was also newly 
found in Shandong Province in 2009.

Chinese gold output 
up by 8.13% in Jan. 
 
 China produced 21.8t gold in Jan. 2010, up by 1.64t or 8.13% y-o-y. 
Among which, the output of mine gold was 17.8t, up by 4.28% y-o-y and the 
output of smelting gold was 4.0t, up by 29.37% y-o-y, according to the 
statistics released by Ministry of Iudustry and Information Technology of the 
People's Republic of China. 
In Jan., Chinese gold enterprises realized combined 10.36billion yuan of 
industrial production value, up by 35.84% y-o-y and created 1.19billion 
yuan of profit, up by 45.7% y-o-y.   
 
China's 
output 
of 
gold in Feb. down by 
20.7% 
China produced 47.4t gold in Feb. 2010, down by 20.7% y-o-y, according 
to the statistics released by National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Mar. 11. 
The output in the first two months this year was 86.6t, down by 2.7% y-o-y. 
 
Zhaojin 
Mining's 
Technology 
Center 
launched 
Zhaojin Mining Co., Ltd (Zhongjin)’s Technology Center held a launching 
ceremony for itself on Mar. 10, which signifies the center, with 200million 
yuan investment, is going to be constructed. The construction period is 
predicted to be one year and three months. 40milliion yuan investment will 
be consumed in 2010. 
 The construction of the new center intends to promote the competition of 
Zhaojin. 
 
SD-Gold saw bright 
performance in 2009 
Shandong Gold Mining Co., Ltd. (SD-Gold, SH 600547) achieved 23.3 
billion yuan of sales revenue in 2009, up by 17.55% y-o-y, according to its 
annual report for 2009. The company's operating profit reached 1.08 billion 
yuan, up by 20.56% on a yearly basis, and the net profit was 746million 
yuan, up by 17.08% y-o-y. Besides, the company plans to allot 5 shares and 
31yuan in each 10 shares.  
 In 2009, the mine gold production of the company reached 17.67t, up by 
11.86% y-o-y. The domestic gold price in 2009 was 214.47yuan/g, up by 
9.65% y-o-y. The increase of gold output and price contributed to the 
growth for the company’s profit. 
Last year, Sanshandao, Xincheng, Jiaojia, Linglong gold mines are 
developing smoothly, which stimulate SD-Gold’s treating ores capacity to 
expand by 4,225t/d. Meanwhile, SD-Gold also successfully acquired the 
prospecting rights for Xinli and Sanshandao deposit areas, which add 45t 
gold metal to the company. 
 
Chinalco, Rio Tinto 
Discuss 
Mongolia 
copper-gold Project 
Aluminum Corp. of China, or Chinalco, seeks to develop more global 
strategic partnerships in the mining sector, and is currently in talks with 
Anglo-Australian miner Rio Tinto Ltd. about the joint development of a 
massive copper and gold mine in Mongolia, Executive Director Liu 
Xiangmin said recently.

With a $15.5 billion investment for about a 9% stake, Chinalco is already 
the single biggest shareholder in Rio Tinto, which owns a 22.4% stake in 
Ivanhoe Mines Ltd., the Canadian company that is developing the Oyu 
Tolgoi copper and gold project in Mongolia.  
Chinalco is also planning to expand its mining capacity to 250,000 metric 
tons per day from the current 100,000 metric tons, according to Mr. Liu.  
 
FinTronics to acquire 
Russia gold mine at 
$300mln 
 
 Chinese producer of ATM, FinTronics Holdings Company Limited 
(FinTronics, HK:00706) plans to acquire 80% shares of a Russia gold mine 
company, SJC Gold Mining Company Omchak (Omchak) at the price of 
US$300mln, source from the company said on Mar. 24.  
Omchak and its subsidiaries are engaged in the business of geological 
exploration and commercial mining of placer gold deposits and hard rock 
gold deposits located in Russia. As at the date of this announcement, 
Omchak owns eight gold projects in Russia, including three producing 
alluvial gold mining operations, a proposed underground gold mine which is 
at a feasibility study stage, and four gold exploration projects. 
FinTronics said it will withhold the current business ATM service and pay 
more attention on natural resource industry. 
 
WGC: 
China's 
demand for gold to 
increase by one time 
in ten years 
 
 World Gold Commission announced on Mar. 29 that it predicted China's 
demand for gold to double on the current base in the next ten years, which 
is mainly pushed by the jewelry consumption and investment demand. 
According to WGC, as to jewelry consumption, China consumed 0.26g of 
it averagely, which is in relatively low level. If demand for gold from jewelry 
section could increase, then there is large space for demand for gold in 
China, as least up by 100t and as high as 4,000t. 
WGC also predicted that the current gold mines China owning was to be 
worked out in six years. 
 
Zijin-Full year report 
for 2009 
 
Zijin Mining Group Co., Ltd. (Zijin, SH601899, HK 2899) released its 
financial report for 2009 indicating its financial results and output details 
last year. 
During the reporting time, Zijin's operation income was 20.956bln yuan, 
up by 23.39% yoy. At the same time, net profit was 3.541bln yuan, up by 
17.84% yoy.

Zhaojin Mining Industry Co., Ltd (Zhaojin Mining, HK:01818) gained 
754mln yuan of net profit in 2009, up by 41.2% y-o-y and the EPS was 
0.52yuan, according to the annual report the company released on Mar. 29. 
Its sales revenue in 2009 was 2.98billion yuan, up by 29.93% y-o-y. 
The company produced 626 kilo OZ gold in 2009, up by 10.59% y-o-y. 
Zhaojin Mining plans to acquire 643 kilo OZ gold mineral resource and 
gold mine's capacity of 48kilo OZ per year this year. In addition, it also plans 
to invest 100million yuan in prospecting mines to prove more than 1,220 
kilo OZ gold mineral resource. 
There are also projects to be reformed and improved with 660million 
yuan of investment this year. If completed, the newly added mining capacity 
for the company could reach 3,000tpd and dressing capacity could be 
3,700tpy. 
 
Tungsten 
 
Jiangxi Dayu County 
optimizes 
its 
tungsten 
industry 
structure 
 
 Dayu County, Jiangxi Province recently surveyed its 16 small size 
tungsten mines and one associated tungsten mine and determined to 
integrate the tungsten resource there. 
The survey started in March 2009. The county govt. aims to consolidate 
the local tungsten resources and develop the deep processing industry, 
therefore to form a tungsten mining, dressing, smelting and processing 
industrial chain.  
The tungsten resources consolidation concerns 14 mining licenses and 
16 prospecting licenses, of which, the local Dayu Huawei Mining Co., Ltd. 
will gain 9 mining licenses and 9 prospecting licenses; another local mining 
company Dayu Longxintai Tungsten Co., Ltd. will obtain the rest licenses. 
Up to now, the Dayu Longxintai Tungsten Co., Ltd. has completed 300 
million yuan investment and has fulfilled the trial operation of 5ktpy APT, 
3.945ktpy tungsten powder and 1.5ktpy tungsten carbide projects.   
 
Final 
findings 
for 
Chinese 
tungsten 
electrode 
anti-dumping 
determined by EU 
 
 The final findings for anti-dumping of tungsten electrode (including 
tungsten rod, bar) produced in China was determined by EU on Feb. 25. It 
is determined that the related anti-dumping rules won’t be changed. The tax 
codes for involved products are ex81019910 and ex85159000. 
EU began to investigate China’s tungsten electrode anti-dumping from 
Dec. 2005 and gave final decision in Mar. 2007, and then reinvestigate the 
case in Dec. 2008. In which, EU collect tax ranging in 25.9%-86.8%.

Yaogangxian 
Tungsten 
mine 
suspends production 
due to accident  
 
Yaogangxian Tungsten Mine based in Chenzhou City, Hunan Province 
suffered blasting fume accident on Mar. 10, which caused 8 staff death, and 
then the company suspended production. So far, it hasn’t resumed 
production. 
The company is held by Hunan Nonferrous Metals Holding Group Co., 
Ltd and has a capacity of 3,000tpy wolframite concentrate.

SZ:002378) plans to issue no more than 43million shares on Mar. 10, and 
the total capital stock won’t exceed 428million shares after the issuing. 
 It is a private group company holding with a complete process line in the 
tungsten industry, whose business include producing, down-stream 
processing and trading on tungsten. 
 
The mining quota for 
tungsten 
in 
2010 
issued 
  
 The Ministry of Land and Resources of China issued the circular of the 
mining quota for tungsten deposit’s exploitation volume in 2010 recently. 
The quota (including mining and integrated utilization) is 80,000t, compared 
with 68,555t in 2009, up by 11,445t or 16.69% y-o-y. Among which, the 
mining quota is 66,480t, compared with 60,440t in 2009, up by 6,040t or 
9.99% y-o-y; the integrated utilization quota is 13,520t, up by 5,405t or 
66.61% y-o-y compared with 8,115t in 2009. 
The quota for Jiangxi and Hunan Provinces accounted for 68.75% of the 
total, down by 3.65% y-o-y, and each of them respectively accounted for 
44% and 24.75% of the total. 
 
China 
Molybdenum 
to be involved in 
tungsten project 
 
 China Molybdenum Co., Ltd (China Molybdenum HK:3993) planned to 
invest 100million yuan in constructing a 2000tpy and a 4500tpy tungsten 
project respectively in Jun. and Oct. this year, the general manager of the 
company said on Mar. 25. 
He also said the acquisition of Nanyang Village Ping Copper-Moly mine 
entered negotiation period and hoped it would be finished as soon as 
quickly, but the detail time table was not confirmed. 
Based in Luoyang City, Henan Province, China Molybdenum is a 
comprehensive enterprise engaging in mining, dressing, smelting and 
deep-processing molybdenum and tungsten, and also specializing in 
researching, producing and trading the related products.

Jiangxi Tungsten Holding Group Co. realized 8.5billion yuan of sales 
revenue in 2009, up by 32.8% y-o-y and created 93.6mln yuan of profit, up 
by 32.39% y-o-y, the company announced on Mar. 25. 
  The project construction of Jiangxi Tungsten got large achievement. For 
instance, the first stage of its 400ktpy secondary metal fabrication project 
was put into production in Mar. 2009 and up to now it has realized 2.83bln 
yuan of sales revenue and 30mln yuan profit. Its 40ktpy nickel-cobalt

Mo deposit found in 
Bayannaoer 
Inner 
Mongolia 
At least 300kt molybdenum resources was found in Wulate Rear Banner 
in Bayannaoer city in Inner Mongolia, according to sources close to the 
situation.  
Wulate Rear Banner is an important nonferrous metals production base. 
The geological experts have successfully detected tungsten and zinc 
resources etc. in the area 
 
China 
Molybdenum 
cut emissions 
China Molybdenum Co., Ltd. (China Molybdenum, HK3993) said recently 
that the company's emission is almost zero. It developed a method of itself 
by making the exhaust gas into acid. And this technology has been put into 
practice since 2007. Now it can produce 24,000t sulfuric acid and 1,500t 
sodium sulfite per year.

acquires 
Diling 
Mining 
to 
develop 
molybdenum 
resource in Henan 
 
 China National Gold Group Corporation (CNGC) signed an agreement 
with Henan's Lushi County Government on Mar. 9 to acquire Diling Mining 
Co., Ltd (Diling Mining) based in the county, sources close to the situation 
said. 
Diling Mining is engaged in producing and processing Molybdenum 
concentrate, iron ore concentrate and so on, but currently stopped 
production. According to CNGC, it will endeavor to resume its production of 
Diling Mining in one month and expand the project as well as put it into 
production at the end of this year. 
 
 
JDC: Yukon Zinc to 
list in HK market 
 
 Acquired by Chinese Jinduicheng Molybdenum Group Co., Ltd. (JDC 
group) in 2008, Canadian company Yukon Zinc is planning to be listed on 
Hongkong stock market this year, according to sources close to the 
situation. Yukon Zinc has two mines. They are Wolverine and Finlayson. 
The former one is set to move in trial production in mid-2010.

 A 20ktpa molybdenum products project was kicked off production in Mar. 
25 in Linxi county, Chifeng city in Inner Mongolia, according to source close 
to the situation. The project is co-invested by Dongbei Special Steel Group 
Co., Ltd. and Chifeng Nanfang Mining Co., and it is planned to be 
constructed by two phases. The whole project is scheduled to be 
commissioned in 2011. 
Rare Earth 
 
Jiangxi Copper's rare 
earth 
project 
in 
Sichuan launched 
 
A project of consolidating rare earth resource in Mianning area, 
Sichuan Province was launched recently. The project belongs to Jiangxi 
Copper Corporation. 
According to related sources, Mianning area is Chinas second largest 
rare earth resource supplying base. The proved rare earth reserve there 
is as high as 2mlnt, and currently 1.57mlnt was left.  
The project includes exploring, dressing, smelting and refining rare 
earth resource. It will be constructed in two stages. The first stage ranges 
from Dec. 2009-Dec. 2011, and 2.06billion yuan investment will be 
injected to construct the whole industry line. The second stage ranging 
from Jan. 2012-Dec.2015 would use 1.6billion yuan investment to 
improve the structure of the industry line.
